data.title: 和栗薰子 · 蛋糕店里的第一小口
data.description: 作为客人来到蛋糕店的薰子穿草莓红开衫和奶油色衬衫，坐在靠窗小桌前小心切下一角蛋糕。她先看了看漂亮的切面，再尝第一口，黑紫长发旁的蓝眼一下子亮起来；桌边还放着出门时带来的小挎包。
data.action: 切下一小角蛋糕观察切面，尝第一口时眼睛亮起来。
data.promptProse: Visiting the cake shop as a customer, Kaoruko Waguri carefully cuts a corner from her cake and inspects its neat cross-section before tasting it. Her blue eyes brighten beneath a cream headband, strawberry-red cardigan covering the collared blouse. The medium view includes her small shoulder bag by the window-side table. Soft window light reveals sponge layers and fork edges, with gentle shade beneath the plate and behind her blackish-purple hair.
